sourceFile: 79.1 TIU L5S3-01  Data check UV dry AWF machine make again standard - 2026.03.18_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misidentifies the primary changed factor and mixes test conditions with subgroup keys.
issues: Primary factor should likely be UV dry peak/total standard change, not Normal versus line and AWF labels.
Line, side, and AWF machine labels are mixed into changedCondition instead of subgroup context.
Baseline/test conditions are ambiguous; Normal rows and AWF rows are not clearly old versus new spec.
Decision row supporting new spec is omitted from cited evidence.
Measurement outcomes from header rows appear over-aggregated and not valid final evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended comparison old UV dry spec versus new peak/total spec?
Are AWF #1-#5 machine IDs, test days, or condition levels?
correctionPlan: Regroup changedFactor around UV dry peak/total standard remake if confirmed.
Move line, side, machine, date, and AWF number into subgroupKeys.
Separate functional NG-rate outcomes from peak/total measurement outcomes.
Cite purpose, table headers, relevant data rows, and decision row.
Remove derived header-stat measurements unless traceable to actual data cells.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for Ask AI until corrected.
